rows.58:0c04:
At that moment, Kazama's eyes glinted.
"Oh, come on, you don't believe my story?
That won't do.
By the time something happens, it'll be too late.
If you absolutely insist on going home alone, then learn this charm before you go.
It goes 'Amazak, Amazak, Amazak...'
You shout it at the ghost over and over.
Got it?{p}
rows.58:0e10:
"So long, then. Adieu."
Adieu, my foot.
Hey, what do I do now?
Do I really have to go home with this guy?
Everyone came out of the club room one after another.
They each walked off down the dark hallway in different directions.
"Come on, let's go home.
Still, that Hino... having a junior this cute. I'm jealous."
Kazama was beaming.
"If you like, I could walk you home every day, starting today.{p}Oh, that'd make us just like a couple, wouldn't it, ha ha ha ha..."
rows.58:3670:
"Hmm..."
At that, Kazama knit his brows.
"You're pretty good."
With that, he closed his eyes and started mumbling something.
What's he going to say this time?
"Lovely, isn't it, hih hih hih hih..."
...What?
What's lovely?
And what's with the 'hih hih hih hih'?{p}
rows.58:1030:
It's fine, I told you.
I'll protect you, no matter what.
Ooh-hoo-hoo."
He's got completely the wrong idea.{p}
rows.58:120c:
"{b}, which way is your house?"
Before I knew it, we had passed through the school gate.
What should I do?
Telling him where I live is a bit...{p}But I can't exactly say farewell right here, either...
rows.58:38b8:
"{b}, which way is your house?"
Before I knew it, we'd reached the school gate.
What should I do?
There's something weird about this guy.
Will I be okay walking home with him?
But I can't exactly say farewell right here, either...{p}
rows.58:13a4:
"...The moon is lovely tonight, isn't it?"
After we had walked a while, Kazama suddenly came out with that.
...Huh?
His eyes had gone completely glassy and fixed.
The mood was getting a little suspicious.{p}
rows.58:1d70:
"Oh, I feel bad.
You even treated me to tea."
A few minutes later, I was serving Kazama tea and snacks.
All because he went and said to whoever in my family answered the door,
"How do you do.
Club activities kept {b} late, so I've come to see her home,"
or something like that.
My family didn't know what was going on, so it turned into 'Oh, thank you so much, please come in and have some tea...'
Kazama took a breather and said,{p}
rows.58:2230:
"I've got a girl I've sworn to spend my future with.
Why, I've just come from greeting her parents, you know?
Thinking you could go after someone like me? How naive."
He was saying things that made no sense.
Who on earth is this guy?
Rather than a saint, isn't he just wildly delusional?{p}
